requirements_summary:

Performance targets (verbatim-ish): “P95 needs to feel instant for analysts; if it’s slow they won’t use it.” They asked for latency percentiles, not just averages. Throughput: expects spiky daytime usage; wants predictable capacity during incident spikes.

Reliability/routing: asked specifically about “noisy neighbor” and regional capacity constraints. Interested in policy-based routing + safe fallback to compatible variants/regions with clear audit trail of what model served the request.

Economics: cost-sensitive but will pay for predictability. They liked the token-level cost breakdown and batching/caching levers; asked for guidance on when caching is safe for their data.

Security/compliance: wants VPC deployment path (or Dedicated with strong isolation story) for production; SSO/SAML for workforce; SCIM nice-to-have; audit logs required (who accessed keys / config changes + request metadata); KMS integration (customer-managed keys preferred); retention controls (log retention policy and ability to export); data residency: US-only to start (asked about EU for future).

demo_notes:
Demo tenant artifacts used: standard 30-min run-of-show (streaming + structured output + tool calling) + Console cost/latency views.

What landed well:
- Token-level cost and latency breakdown in Console; they liked “you can show me where the money goes.”
- Dedicated capacity narrative: isolation + predictable throughput; they asked “can we reserve GPUs and still burst?”
- Reliability story: fallback routing + graceful degradation; they want explicit controls (what can fallback to what) and visibility.

What didn’t land / risks:
- 429 throttling incident (demo). They asked for “how do you guardrail this so our analysts don’t see failures?” and wanted rate-limit policy guidance.
- They want a crisp explanation of Dedicated vs Private (VPC) boundaries: what’s shared, what isn’t, and how audit logs differ.

Open questions from them:
- Can we pin model versions for compliance change-control while still getting safety patches?
- Can audit logs be exported to Splunk (or standard JSON) and what events are included?
- What is the default retention window for request metadata and can it be set per-project?

Internal note: keep their future demos on a separate isolated demo project namespace (parallel demo collisions were mentioned in sales Slack).
deal_strategy_notes_internal:
Positioning: lead with ‘production economics + reliability’ (their pain is predictable performance under load) and only then cover model catalog breadth.

Packaging: propose Dedicated in US region with explicit quota/throughput commitments; keep Private/VPC as phase 2 if they require customer-managed networking day 1.

Mitigate 429 concern: show healthcheck + quota dashboard early, explain backpressure + retries, and highlight Dedicated reserve eliminates shared pool contention.

Artifacts to re-use: demo reset runbook + model pinning/fallback ADR (internal references) for our internal prep; externally, provide a simplified one-pager on model pinning + change-control.
